response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience with developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, frameworks), and a proven track record in technical leadership and open-source contributions, but lacks explicit evidence of people management experience beyond mentoring and workshops, and has no demonstrated mobile-platform or organizational change leadership — key preferred qualifications for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven technical leadership through open-source projects and workshop creation
Broad stack expertise across mobile, web, and systems languages (TypeScript, DLang, Swift, C++)
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership responsibilities
Lacks documented experience with mobile platform ecosystems (iOS/Android) as required
Minimal indication of strategic roadmap planning or organizational change leadership
